# Copilot Instructions

`Region42.PantherShootout` is a .NET 10 web application for tracking schedules, scores, pool-play standings, championship brackets, and Penalty Shootout (PSO) standings for AYSO Region 42's annual Panther Shootout youth soccer tournament.

To keep guidance unified across IDEs, start by reading [`README.md`](../README.md) at the solution root. It contains the domain overview, 4-layer Clean/Onion architecture rules (`Domain <- Application`, `Domain <- Infrastructure`, `Web -> all`), related `Region42.ScoresStandings` context, and links to detailed specifications under [`docs/`](../docs/) (including `docs/BusinessRules.md` and `docs/json-storage.md`) that should be loaded into context as needed.
